records.c: Level 2 glyph pixels for character codes 0 through 127, eight rows per glyph. $CAA6 indexes this charset when testing a hull overlap.
Level 2 glyph pixels for character codes 128 through 255. The solid-character mask at $8024 uses these codes as well as those in the lower half.

Level 2 solid-character mask. Index this 32-byte table with the character code shifted right 3, then test the bit from $1457 indexed by the low three bits. The shot and hull tests read it at $2FCF and $CA8E.
